notes: Card: ' of', ' into', ' for', ' vs' x2, ' duel' x2: no single token, encyclopedic prose. Probe weak: 'the inspiration for' 0.35, 'remnants of' 0.14 (peak elsewhere), plain 'walked into' / 'gift for' ~0.02. Near misses keep the same prepositions in literal spatial or benefactive use.
